Hi Avery,

Per our pre-call triage, I pulled a focused list of technical requirements and defaults we typically recommend for VPC-peered private deployments. Below are the concrete items we need from your networking/security team prior to the meeting: (I kept them short so the call can confirm specifics)

Required information from Nightingale:
- Control plane peer VPC CIDR(s): e.g., 10.200.0.0/16 (we need VPC ID and exact CIDRs for peering).
- CIDRs for any subnets that will host on‑prem agents (for routing & firewall rules).
- Preferred private endpoint subnet range (we reserve a /24 per environment; default suggestion: 10.250.50.0/24).
- NAT/egress pattern: do your nodes use a centralized NAT gateway or per-AZ NAT? We need to know whether egress IPs are static for allowlisting.
- TLS termination: do you provide a public CA cert for *.nightingalebio.com or do you require mutual TLS with a client cert?
- KMS/HSM: if you require customer-managed keys for secrets, provide KMS ARNs and IAM role that Redwood should assume.

Redwood recommended defaults / ports to open on your outbound firewall (egress):
- TCP 443 to control-plane private endpoints (HTTPS)
- TCP 5222 for agent heartbeats (optional, we can multiplex over 443)
- UDP 123 for NTP or ensure accurate time via internal NTP
- Outbound access to our package mirror endpoints: packages.redwood.ai (unless you are air-gapped)

Example peering routes we program on our side (for your routing team) — for peered VPC X: 
- route 10.10.0.0/16 -> vpc-peering-abc123
- route 10.250.50.0/24 -> vpc-peering-abc123 (private endpoints)

On‑prem installer notes:
- Installer uses container images (OCI). If you are air‑gapped we provide an offline bundle and a small helper to load images behind your registry.
- Requires: systemd >= 246, docker/CRI-O runtime (we recommend containerd 1.6+), 8GB RAM per node for pilot.
- Default ports: 3000, 9000 (for metrics) — configurable.

I attached a peering template config you can hand to your networking team to speed the review. We'll validate during the call and lock fields for the order form.

Attachment: priyom_vpc_peering_template.conf

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
